workbookSwapUnavailable: This workbook comparison cannot reload swapped sources. Reload the comparison and try again.
toolbarDiffOnlyTitle: Hide unchanged workbook rows and keep only headers and differences
toolbarDiffOnlyQuickTitle: Hide unchanged rows and show differences only
diffFilterAllTitle: Show all difference types in the current scope
diffFilterAddedUnavailableTitle: No added differences in the current scope
diffFilterModifiedUnavailableTitle: No modified differences in the current scope
diffFilterDeletedUnavailableTitle: No deleted differences in the current scope
toolbarBotTitle: Show the draggable Bot and diff insights
toolbarCompareModeStrictTitle: Strict mode: spaces and empty values both count as diffs
toolbarCompareModeStatusStrictHint: Strict mode is active: spaces, tabs, and empty-value differences are all preserved.
toolbarCompareModeStatusContentHint: Content mode is active: differences caused only by blank whitespace are ignored.
toolbarSplitPaneResizeText: Resize left and right text panes
toolbarSplitPaneResizeWorkbook: Resize left and right workbook panes
toolbarPickFileTitle: Choose a new working-copy file or diff target
toolbarSwitchFileTitle: Open another working-copy file or diff target in a new tab
toolbarUpdateInstallConfirm: Installing the update will close the current comparison window and show the in-place installation progress. When it finishes, you can choose whether to reopen the app. Continue?
updateBotAvailableMessage: The new release is ready. Downloading will not interrupt your comparison.
updateBotDownloadingMessage: I’ll let you know when it is ready to install.
updateBotDownloadedMessage: Installing closes this window, so save anything you need first.
globalBotWorkbookStructureSummary: Worksheet structure changed: {added} added, {deleted} deleted, and {renamed} renamed.
globalBotWorkbookArtifactOnly: Cell content matches, but the workbook binary structure is different.
globalBotNoDifferences: I checked both sides; their content matches.
devLoaderHintElectron: Choose a working-copy file and review changes between the current content and its version history
appLoadingHint: The window is visible while large files are parsed and diffed in the background
appIdleHintElectron: Waiting for external diff arguments. Reopen the app with both input files to start a comparison.
rendererErrorBody: You can retry or close the window first. If the issue persists, copy or export the diagnostic log.
rendererErrorCopied: The diagnostic log was copied to the clipboard.
rendererErrorCopyFailed: Copy failed. Please use "Export Log" instead.
homeStartHeroBody: Compare local files, Excel workbooks, Git versions, and SVN revisions in one focused workspace.
homeStartCapabilityTitle: Text and workbooks in one review
homeStartCapabilityBody: Compare code, configs, documents, and spreadsheet changes without switching views.
homeStartLaunchModeTitle: Manual open, external launch straight to diff
homeStartLaunchModeBody: Choose a file and Versora will detect Git or SVN automatically, or jump straight in from TortoiseSVN.
homeStartPickBody: Choose a working-copy file and review changes between the current content and its version history.
homeStartConfigBody: Set Versora as the external TortoiseSVN viewer.
homeStartDesktopOnly: This is not a desktop environment. File picking and TortoiseSVN integration are only available inside the Electron desktop app.
localFileCompareSubtitle: Choose two files to compare. Excel workbooks and text files are supported, and both files must have the same extension.
localFileCompareSmartModeVersioned: Git / SVN: detect each side and enable revision switching.
localFileCompareSmartModePlain: Plain files: compare current content; only versioned sides can switch.
localFileCompareBaseHint: Usually the trunk, release branch, or earlier version
localFileCompareMineHint: Usually the feature branch or later version
localFileCompareDropReplaceHint: Release to replace the selected file
localFileCompareDropMultiple: Drop only one file on each side.
localFileCompareDropDirectory: Drop a file; folders are not supported.
localFileCompareDropUnavailable: The local path for this file is unavailable. Use Choose file instead.
localFileCompareFilePlaceholder: Supports Excel workbooks and text files
localFileCompareMissingFiles: Choose both a baseline file and a comparison file.
localFileCompareTypeMismatch: Choose two files with the same extension.
svnConfigSubtitle: Choose a mode and file comparisons started from TortoiseSVN will prefer Versora.
svnConfigAvailabilityPackagedOnly: Use this from the installed desktop build
svnConfigAvailabilityLauncherMissing: The SVN launcher is missing. Reinstall Versora.
svnConfigDefaultCommandFallback: Still using the default diff viewer
svnConfigAllFilesBody: Open every file comparison with Versora.
svnConfigTextOnlyBody: Use Versora for text changes. Workbook comparisons stay as they are.
svnConfigWorkbookOnlyBody: Only workbook files use Versora. Other file types stay as they are.
svnConfigSupportHint: The configuration is written for the current Windows user. After that, file diffs started from TortoiseSVN will open with the same rule set.
svnConfigRestoreDefaultBody: Disconnect Versora and remove its external viewer rules so TortoiseSVN returns to its default behavior.
svnConfigRestoreDefaultHint: This also happens automatically before uninstall, so SVN diff commands are not left pointing to a missing app.
workbookMiniMapAriaLabel: Worksheet diff mini map; use arrow and page keys to scroll
textMiniMapAriaLabel: File diff mini map; use arrow and page keys to scroll
workbookParserRustHint: For .xls / .xlsb support, switch to the Rust parser next.
revisionPickerPinnedSourcesHint: These are switch-back sources such as the working copy or input files; the current selection is still the highlighted commit below
revisionPickerNoDateResultsHint: Pick another date or clear the filter to view the full timeline
revisionPickerSearchRangeHint: Load older revisions to extend the search range
revisionPickerSameVersionHint: Both sides use the same revision, so no diff needs to be loaded. Choose another revision.
workbookSheetTabTooltipSheetHint: This worksheet exists in both the base and current versions.
workbookSheetTabTooltipChangedHint: This worksheet exists in both versions and contains cell-level differences.
workbookSheetTabTooltipAddedTitle: Worksheet added in the current version
workbookSheetTabTooltipAddedHint: This worksheet only exists in the current version and marks a newly added worksheet.
workbookSheetTabTooltipDeletedTitle: Worksheet deleted from the current version
workbookSheetTabTooltipDeletedHint: This worksheet only exists in the base version and is no longer present now.
workbookSheetTabTooltipRenameSourceHint: The worksheet still exists in the current version, but its worksheet name has changed.
workbookSheetTabTooltipRenameTargetTitle: Current worksheet (renamed from an older worksheet)
workbookSheetTabTooltipRenameTargetHint: This worksheet comes from an older base worksheet and now uses a new worksheet name.
collapseJumpPrevTitle: Jump to the previous collapsed block (Alt+[)
collapseJumpNextTitle: Jump to the next collapsed block (Alt+])
searchResultsEmpty: No search results to display for the current filters
searchResultsKeyboardHint: Arrow keys to move · Enter to jump
searchResultsKeyboardHintText: Arrow keys to jump between results
searchResultsKeyboardHintWorkbook: Arrow keys to jump between results
gotoHint: Enter a line number between 1 and {totalLines}
gotoEmpty: There is no content available to jump to
gotoInvalid: Enter a valid line number greater than 0
gotoOutOfRange: Out of range. The highest available line is {totalLines}
gotoPreview: Press Enter or click Go to jump to line {lineNo}
aboutSubtitle: A focused Windows comparison workspace for text, Excel, Git, and SVN.
aboutReleaseNotesEmpty: No release notes are available yet. Run an update check after publishing a GitHub Release to load them here.
aboutReleaseNotesDisabledHint: Release notes are unavailable in dev mode because automatic update metadata is not loaded.
aboutReleaseNotesUnsupportedHint: Release notes are currently only loaded for Windows automatic updates.
aboutReleaseNotesCheckingHint: Checking GitHub Releases now. Release notes will appear here after the request completes.
aboutReleaseNotesNoChangesHint: No newer release notes were loaded because the current build is already on the latest published version.
aboutUninstallConfirm: This will close the current comparison window, launch the native Windows uninstaller, restore TortoiseSVN's default viewer first, and then let you choose whether to delete personal Versora data. Continue?
aboutUpdateDisabledHint: Automatic updates are only available in packaged Windows builds.
aboutUpdateUnsupportedHint: Automatic updates are currently only implemented for Windows.
aboutUpdateErrorFallback: The update check failed. Try again later.
aboutUpdateAvailableHint: A newer release is available: {version}. You can download it from this dialog.
updateInstalledNoticeTitle: Versora has been updated to v{version}
shortcutPrevCollapse: Jump to the previous collapsed block
shortcutNextCollapse: Jump to the next collapsed block
statsArtifactOnlyDiffHintPrimary: Workbook cell content is unchanged, but the workbook binary differs.
statsArtifactOnlyDiffHintSecondary: This usually comes from non-cell layers such as export timestamps, package structure, macro containers, or other metadata.
artifactNoticeTitle: This comparison has no cell-level changes, but the workbook artifact changed
artifactNoticeBody: This usually comes from non-cell layers such as export timestamps, package structure, macro containers, or other metadata. The main view still treats the workbook as content-equal.
workbookStackedMergeNoticeTitle: The current viewport contains {count} multi-row merged regions, so stacked mode is using simplified vertical rendering
workbookStackedMergeNoticeBody: Near single-sided edits, collapsed blocks, hidden rows, or freeze boundaries, merged cells are shown as semantic segments. Switch to Columns or Left/Right view when you need a more complete worksheet geometry.
workbookFrozenColumnsWindowHintCurrent: Drag the scrollbar to inspect the current frozen-column viewport
workbookFrozenColumnsWindowHintShared: Drag the scrollbar to inspect the frozen-column viewport shared by both panes
workbookFrozenPaneHint: Drag the scrollbar to inspect the frozen region
sourceNoticeUnversionedTitle: This file is not under version control
sourceNoticeUnversionedBody: It has been opened as a local file. Version switching is unavailable because no Git or SVN history was found.
statsHints: F7 next · Shift+F7 prev · Ctrl+F search · Ctrl+G goto · F1 shortcuts
statsHintsWithoutGoto: F7 next · Shift+F7 prev · Ctrl+F search · F1 shortcuts
statsLineSelectionHint: Right-click to fold or copy version lines; click the same line number or blank space to clear selection
manualSelectionBarHint: Shift to extend · click blank area to clear
manualSelectionLineNumberHint: Click to select · Shift to extend
formulaBarHint: Select a cell to inspect its formula
formulaBarEmpty: The selected cell does not contain a formula
workbookContextRevealAllRows: Reveal all hidden rows on this worksheet
workbookContextRevealAllColumns: Reveal all hidden columns on this worksheet
workbookHiddenColumnsTooltip: {count} columns collapsed or hidden. Click to reveal.
tooltipWhitespaceSensitiveHint: Note: this difference is caused only by whitespace and is kept in Strict mode but ignored in Content mode.
tooltipClearedHint: Note: {mineLabel} cleared this cell while {baseLabel} still has content.
tooltipAddedHint: Note: {mineLabel} added content to this cell while {baseLabel} was empty.
